extension.summary: A picture of where you are skipping to, in any skin
extension.description: While you skip forward or back in a video, a small frame of the spot you are jumping to shows above the seek bar, like on YouTube or Netflix. It works in every skin because the add-on draws the box itself, and it needs nothing else installed: ffmpeg is included. Local files, network shares (SMB, NFS) and http streams are supported.
extension.disclaimer: Decodes video frames in the background while a film plays. Includes ffmpeg (GPL).
